Name: small_mlp_dropout
Title: Does dropout help a small classifier with scarce noisy data?
Short Hypothesis: Dropout improves validation accuracy when a small MLP trains on scarce noisy data.
Related Work: Dropout is an established regularization method. Verify relevant literature before interpreting this illustrative study as a research contribution.
Abstract: Compare a small two-layer MLP with and without dropout on synthetic two-dimensional classification data using fixed splits and multiple random seeds.
Experiments: Train for at most 20 epochs per variant and finish each script in under five minutes.
Report accuracy, runtime and variation across seeds; retain negative results.
Risk Factors and Limitations: Synthetic results do not establish real-world effectiveness.
This example validates the pipeline, not scientific novelty.
